# domainchief_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the DNS records of a domain that uses Domain Chief hosted DNS, for example to import an existing zone.

Requires a token with the `domainchief:dns:read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "domainchief_dns_records" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

# The records you manage yourself, skipping the ones Domain Chief manages for web redirects, mail forwarding and ACME challenges.
output "own_records" {
  value = [
    for record in data.domainchief_dns_records.example.records : "${record.type} ${record.name} ${record.content}"
    if record.managed_by == null
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name or domain ID to list the records of.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Only return records of this type, one of `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `ALIAS`, `CAA`, `SRV`, `TLSA`, `NS`.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) The DNS records of the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) The comment of the record, if any.
- `content` (String) The record content, TXT content is returned without surrounding quotes.
- `id` (String) The ID of the DNS record.
- `managed_by` (String) The Domain Chief feature that manages this record: `web_redirect`, `mail_forwarding` or `acme_challenge`. Null for records you manage yourself. Manage these records through their feature, for example with `domainchief_web_redirect`, instead of as a `domainchief_dns_record`. More values may be added in the future.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the record, without the keys managed by Domain Chief.
- `name` (String) The record name relative to the domain, empty for the domain itself.
- `priority` (Number) The record priority, `0` for types without a priority.
- `ttl` (Number) The record TTL in seconds.
- `type` (String) The record type.
